title: UK Generations Study — R0 Questionnaire table
description: Array of R0 baseline questionnaire records. One element is one participant's round-0 questionnaire response. Pilot package: only the general_information category is converted so far; the remaining 18 sections (see PROGRESS.md) are pending.
$comment: Standard JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness of StudyID across rows. See the README's 'Documented but not enforced' section.

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern: the participant ticked 'don't know my GP's name', so a substantive GP name is structurally inconsistent -- R0_GP must carry the missing-string sentinel.
